target: Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 / ROS 2 Jazzy / mock hardware
policy: ROS apt source and downloaded assets are pinned by version/commit and hashes. Apt installs the current signed Jazzy packages; these observed versions are a tested reference, not a complete immutable apt snapshot. Differences are reported and require runtime acceptance checks.
project_gui_dependency_note: fonts-noto-cjk provides Chinese glyphs for this project's UI; it is a project display dependency, separate from upstream Slicer's required libraries.
